description: This file is a Java configuration class for setting up OpenAPI documentation within the inventory-service module of a Shopizer-based project. It defines API metadata and tags for the inventory API, including inventory and health endpoints.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that defines a bean for OpenAPI specification for the inventory service.

methods.name: inventoryOpenApi
methods.description: Creates and returns an OpenAPI object with metadata and tags for the inventory service API.
